title: Monoco's Station - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Monoco's Station in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The station settlement that unlocks once Monoco joins the party. It is the main merchant hub of Act 2 and the source of several Monoco weapons.

sections.title: How to Reach Monoco's Station
sections.content: Unlocked in Act 2. Fast travel becomes available from here.
